title: A coequalizer presentation with finite supports is a filtered colimit of finite coequalizers
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space. Suppose a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ is a coequalizer [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of maps $r,s:\coprod_{b\in B}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\rightrightarrows\coprod_{a\in A}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$, with extension by the empty set as in [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty], and suppose every finite subset of source indices has a finite target support for both maps as in [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-finite-relation-truncations]. Then $\mathcal F$ is a directed colimit of sheaves, each of which is a coequalizer of two maps between finite coproducts of the displayed form. The index set is the directed set of finite source subsets together with finite target supports.
